The confidence interval widths reflect well-established empirical patterns in financial time series: uncertainty scales with the square root of time, which is why the 1-day interval spans roughly 26 points, the 1-week interval widens to 50 points, and the 1-month interval opens up to 100 points. I should be transparent that without knowing the exact asset, current price, or date of this forecast, my reasoning is necessarily generic.
